# Third-party code in this kit

`harness/common/dedup_local.py` contains functions copied verbatim from
[gradients-ai/G.O.D](https://github.com/gradients-ai/G.O.D) at commit `b49ba8644a0d705e9b035746eceaa05614742934`
(`validator/infrastructure/repo_dedup.py`, `validator/tournament/repo_diff_report.py`, and the prompt text of
`repo_dedup_config.json`; the docstring of `dedup_local.py` lists the exact line ranges).

Those portions remain under the upstream license and notice, reproduced unmodified in `G.O.D/LICENSE.md` and
`G.O.D/NOTICE`. Attribution: this product includes software developed by Grads LLC — Gradients.io (https://gradients.io).
Everything else in this kit is original to the kit.
